name: Insify
what: Digital insurer (MGA) selling business insurance to freelancers and SMEs in the Netherlands, Germany and France.
homonym_note: Not Insurify (US car-insurance marketplace). The Accel sibling row is the same company.

membership.basis: Listed on the live visionaries.vc portfolio (companies-2026); press names Visionaries Club as a new investor in the Feb 2022 Series A and as a follow-on investor in 2023 and 2025.
membership.quote: In addition to Accel, Visionaries Club, existing investors Frontline Ventures and Fly Ventures

entry.quote: raised a $17 million (€15 million) Series A round led by Accel

valuation.quote: No priced valuation published for any round.

notes: Entry was the Series A (Visionaries named as a new participant; the existing investors named separately were Frontline and Fly Ventures), so graduation does not apply. Visionaries followed on in the June 2023 extension ('existing investors ... Berlin's Visionaries Club', Insurance Journal) and the Sept 2025 Series B ('follow-on support from ... Visionaries Club', TFN). Vehicle hint is inferred from the 2022 date and Series A stage (Seed Fund I and Growth Fund I both possible; Growth Fund I invests Series B onwards), low confidence. Agrees with the Accel sibling (Series A, Amsterdam, Fintech & Payments). Google News search '"Insify"' shows nothing on status beyond a May 2026 Chubb product launch.
